$comment: Configuration for .github/scripts/visual-gate. Every excludeStories entry needs the reason the story cannot reproduce itself — the list stays reviewable instead of growing quietly, and `gate.mjs flaky` is how entries are found (run it, do not guess). A key ending in * covers a whole story file.
$probeTheme: A generated fixture styling every declared target (packages/themes/probe). The gate treats it as the coverage instrument, not a design: it is what makes a NEW theming target verified from the day its doc lands.
$stableStoryPackages: Only these Storybook package groups participate in the stable baseline. Canary-only packages have no stable visual baseline.
$prVisualShotLimit: Review ceiling for focused component shots and broad shared-infrastructure plans. Theme-only matrices are not component-budgeted.
$visualPlanSafetyLimit: Absolute resource ceiling for every ordinary and trusted visual plan, regardless of scope.
$scoutConcurrency: Scouting is independent by story and uses two bounded browser contexts on the pinned two-core runner.
$captureConcurrency: Independent stories may capture concurrently, but every shot for one story stays on one worker so seeded state and fast theme switches remain deterministic.
$compareConcurrency: PNG decoding and pixel comparison run on two CPU workers after browser capture closes.

excludeStories.lab-chartstreamgl--*: Streams live data on a setInterval; every frame is a different chart.
excludeStories.lab-chartstreamperf--*: Renders measured fps and frame times, which differ every run by construction.
excludeStories.lab-codeeditorperf--*: Renders performance.now() mount timings on screen.
